answer: Copying the same citations across 110 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 110 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the ripple check immediately, the tundra audit keeps the resolved set and the sparrow replay reveals exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
